designs.name: Pužicina jagodica
designs.prompt: Create ONE completely original invitation BACKGROUND, one single full-bleed upright image, EXACT 5:7 aspect ratio, preferred 1500x2100 pixels. No text, letters, numbers, logo, signature, watermark, pseudo-writing or printed labels. No collage, grid, panels or multiple variants. No mockup, paper sheet, tabletop, hands, perspective view of stationery, external shadow or border frame. Flat straight-on artwork filling the canvas. All important ornaments MUST be fully visible, uncropped and at least 8% of the image width away from EVERY edge; ground and faint texture alone may reach edges. Keep a broad genuinely calm high-contrast area for LARGE editable invitation text; do not fill it with details. Elegant crisp forms suitable for mobile and print. Do not render any concept title. Theme: a tender first birthday for a little girl. One charming tiny snail with a softly peach shell beside ONE ripe strawberry and a small strawberry blossom, illustrated in refined opaque storybook gouache, warm ivory, pale mint, muted strawberry red. Place the complete little scene in the LOWER RIGHT quadrant, within x=62–88%, y=73–90%. A few very small soft mint leaves at upper left, safely inset. Keep central/upper 80% of the page pale ivory and calm; no dense surrounding floral frame. Gentle playful handmade brush shapes, no childish lettering, no candles, no birthday numerals. The snail and strawberry are readable cute characters with sound anatomy. Compositional emphasis is asymmetrical lower-right; leave especially clear space at upper center and lower left.
